# Old King Lab

> Old King Lab publishes small productivity and game-development tools. This static site is the canonical source for the products listed below.

## ResizeMint – Right-Click Image Resizer for Mac

ResizeMint is a native macOS image resizing utility for people who frequently prepare images for websites, documents, messages, app listings, and design handoffs. Its primary feature is Finder integration: select supported images, open the right-click menu, and resize by a saved percentage or exact pixel-size preset without opening a full image editor.

For larger jobs, ResizeMint has a native batch workspace. Users can drag in individual images, multiple images, or folders; preview the resized result; lock the aspect ratio; set width, height, or percentage; view output information; and export the current image or all queued images. Finder percentage and pixel-size presets can be added, removed, reordered, and edited in the app.

ResizeMint supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, HEIC, WebP, and TIFF. Its interface can follow the macOS language or use English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, or Arabic. ResizeMint requires macOS 14 or later.

All image processing happens locally on the Mac. ResizeMint has no account system, cloud image processing, advertising, analytics, or tracking, and it does not upload images to the developer. It is available for macOS exclusively through the Mac App Store.

- Product page: https://ai.oldking.wang/ResizeMint/
- Support & Feedback: https://ai.oldking.wang/ResizeMint/#support (questions, bug reports, and feature suggestions via the embedded Tally form)
- Privacy Policy: https://ai.oldking.wang/ResizeMint/privacy.html
- Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/resizemint/id6809292122

## DockLoom – Customizable Mac App & File Launcher

DockLoom is a native macOS menu bar launcher for apps, files, folders, command scripts, and local HTML files. It provides a resizable shortcut window and grid, Finder drag-and-drop, free shortcut positioning and swapping, custom aliases, built-in custom icons, icon and background colors, adjustable slot and label sizes, seven themes, and a localized interface.

DockLoom can be used as a customizable alternative to a traditional Mac Apps Launcher or Launchpad-style workflow. Unlike an app-only launcher, DockLoom places local files, folders, scripts, and HTML pages in the same personal grid as Mac apps.

DockLoom is available for macOS exclusively through the Mac App Store. It does not include an account system, cloud sync, advertising, analytics, or tracking. Shortcut references and preferences are stored locally on the user’s Mac, and customizing or removing a shortcut does not rename, move, modify, or delete its original target.

- Product page: https://ai.oldking.wang/dockloom/
- Privacy Policy: https://ai.oldking.wang/dockloom/privacy.html
- Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dockloom/id6806755726

## OverPad – Floating Scratchpad

OverPad is a native macOS floating Markdown scratchpad. It opens from a draggable 48×48 pt orb and supports multiple notes, live Markdown styling, syntax-highlighted fenced code blocks, 19 color themes, eight interface languages, custom fonts, 60%–240% zoom, automatic local saving, cross-Space panels, menu-bar collapse, and an optional macOS login item.

OverPad is currently available only for macOS. It does not include an account system, cloud sync, collaboration, advertising, analytics, tracking, or built-in AI. Notes and preferences are stored locally on the user’s Mac.

- Product page: https://ai.oldking.wang/overpad/
- Privacy Policy: https://ai.oldking.wang/overpad/privacy.html
- Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/overpad/id6805057491
